environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate behind AWS ALB. An AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB containing a custom rule group 'api-schema-enforcement-rg' with priority 1. This rule group contains a regex-pattern-set rule matching on the 'target' and 'url' query string parameters. The regex pattern set 'blocked-ssrf-patterns' includes patterns: `(?i)(169\.254\.|metadata|\[::ffff:|0x[a-f0-9]|%30|%31%36%39|localhost|127\.|10\.|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|192\.168\.)` applied with a BLOCK action on TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE. Additionally, a second rule 'hostname-bypass-block' uses a regex `[^a-z0-9.-]` on the hostname portion extracted via a custom header X-Parsed-Host set by a Lambda@Edge origin-request function that extracts and normalizes the hostname from the query parameter URL before forwarding. The Lambda@Edge function performs iterative URL decoding (up to 5 passes) and DNS resolution of the hostname, blocking if the resolved IP falls within RFC1918/link-local ranges. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL 'api-gateway-acl' attached

waf_rules.name: hostname-bypass-block
waf_rules.behavior: iterative decode + DNS resolution + RFC1918 check

config.network: VPC with unrestricted outbound, IMDSv1 enabled
